about_the_game:
A Tower Defense Battle for the Island!

An army of alien invaders has arrived, polluting the once-peaceful ocean world of the Crabby Fishes! As the leader of the resistance, build defenses, deploy powerful aquatic allies, and fight to reclaim your home.

Key Features:

🦀 Tactical Tower Defense - strategically place defenders to stop waves of enemies
🌊 Unique Aquatic Units – command a team of quirky sea creatures, each with special abilities
♻️ Eco-Twist – battle pollution and clean up your ocean while fighting off foes
🔥 Dynamic Battles – face ever-changing threats with adaptable strategies
🎨 Vibrant Hand-Drawn Art – a colorful and lively underwater world awaits

🔍 Hidden Treasures – explore levels to uncover secret items and bonuses that aid your defense

Are you ready to save the island?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz or higher) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU compatible with DirectX 11 (or integrated graphics supporting WebGL2)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard sound card supported by Windows
  • VR Support: VR devices not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Can a bunch of crabs save the ocean? Dive into a dynamic, hand-drawn tower defense where quirky sea creatures battle alien polluters. Build, upgrade, and unleash wild abilities in fast-paced, chaotic battles. Immerse yourself in a vibrant, colorful world as you fight to reclaim the reef!
supported_languages:
English*, Ukrainian*, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
